data_objects.name: paired_score_versions
data_objects.meaning: Application-level records pairing old and new versions of two continuous scores.

variables.name: uniq_id
variables.meaning: Record identifier encoded with a U prefix and zero-padded number.

variables.name: apply_date
variables.meaning: Application calendar date encoded as YYYYMMDD.

variables.name: score1_new
variables.meaning: New-version value for score family 1 on the same record.

variables.name: score2_new
variables.meaning: New-version value for score family 2 on the same record.

structure.description: Each row is a matched comparison unit: old and new values for both score families share uniq_id and apply_date.

uncertainties: The score families' business meanings and calibration are not supplied.
annotation_notes: The old/new columns are paired by row; their names indicate version, not separate populations.
